chainFacts.says: Token-2022 with a permanent delegate (move or burn any balance) behind a 2-of-3 Squads vault with no time lock, freeze and pause behind a 2-of-4 Squads vault with no time lock, a hot mint key and a hot rebase key, shared across all 828 mints.
No transfer or burn on Solana names the permanent delegate as authority across 1,845 transactions from 10 Jun 2025 to 23 Sep 2026.
Redeemed tokens are de-activated by transfer back to an issuer wallet, not burned, so supply overstates the public float.

outside.says: KYC-approved direct clients outside the US, UK, Canada and Australia, from $5,000, paid in cash by T+5; the gated xPort channel returns shares to an Alpaca account. Stays in the prospectus and Backed's onboarding.

The terms let Backed freeze and pause; lost tokens are cancelled only after a Zug court rules, after a public notice of at least a month. Stays in the prospectus and Swiss law; the chain shows the capability.
Chainlink is the official oracle for prices and corporate actions; markets set the token price.

ingredients.label: Issuer's token terms (T) on the mint
A custodian's holdings under A, under 30 days
The security agent's pledge for holders

verdict.summary: The structure is A/H/T plus a pledge for the class of holders, so its outline can be said. The token cannot be read (Token-2022 on every chain), the pledge cannot name holders as a class, and 'issuer-obligation' hides that the claim is secured debt payable only in cash. The issuer publishes most of its own side; the custodians, the security agent and the reserve examiner publish nothing in their own name.
